title: MINOR-PI09-1: Make public schema pollution check explicit (allowlist or tenant-scoped)
summary: Follow-on to ISS-0084: tests/integration/startup_assertions_test.zig accepts PublicSchemaPollution as PASS in addition to the expected PASS. This was necessary to keep 5/5 green at PR #690 merge time but creates a contract where 'PASS' is ambiguous. Hard pre-check of public schema in the test itself, before invocation, plus strict (non-polymorphic) PASS contract.

root_cause.details: Integration test contract permits an outcome the production assertion rejects (PublicSchemaPollution), masking future assertion changes.
